name: Executive Minimal
description: Light-forward, low-decoration theme built directly from Databricks' AI/BI theming guidance (60% neutral background, 30% supporting font/data color, 10% accent) for leadership-facing dashboards where restraint reads as authority.
provenance: Constructed 2026-07-28 following the 60-30-10 framework and accessibility guidance in https://www.databricks.com/blog/design-beautiful-dashboards-aibi (softened neutrals instead of pure black/white; 5-color palette spaced to avoid red/green adjacency). Not extracted from a live dashboard export.
